metadata.source: Kaggle JobStreet Malaysia All Job Dataset (azraimohamad/jobstreet-all-job-dataset)
metadata.method: Share of postings mentioning a skill (per 1,000 postings) in a baseline window vs a recent window.
caveats: Two windows from one public snapshot, not a continuous time series.
Skills are extracted keywords; a posting can mention several.
Skills with fewer than the minimum postings in either window are labelled low_sample and are not used for scoring.
Changes describe past postings and are estimates, not forecasts.
